INSERT INTO lead_enrichment_runs (
  run_id,
  received_at,
  lead_name,
  lead_email,
  lead_company_domain,
  enrichment_data,
  score,
  criteria_met,
  reasoning,
  hubspot_contact_id,
  hubspot_deal_id,
  hubspot_deal_stage,
  processed_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Validate Lead Payload').item.json.run_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Validate Lead Payload').item.json.received_at }}'::timestamptz,
  '{{ $('Validate Lead Payload').item.json.lead.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Validate Lead Payload').item.json.lead.email.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Validate Lead Payload').item.json.lead.company_domain.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Extract Enrichment Signals').item.json.enrichment).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $('Parse Score').item.json.score }}',
  {{ $('Parse Score').item.json.criteria_met_sql }},
  '{{ $('Parse Score').item.json.reasoning.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Create HubSpot Contact').first().json.results[0].id }}',
  '{{ $('Create HubSpot Deal').item.json.id }}',
  '{{ $('Create HubSpot Deal').item.json.properties.dealstage }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING;
